name: a scroll
text:
Larkin, 
  This is now the fifth straight day that I have detected an interdimensional disturbance in the ether.  Judging from the proportional increases, I am now surer than ever that something monstrously powerful is fast approaching our planet.  The council has thus far refused to acknowledge the import of my observations, but I am convinced that we are potentially in grave danger.  Could you place me on the agenda for the next council meeting?  Thanks.
          -Devrow

          Signed, Rovilar
